title: Chorus contours
description: Faces drawn only as contours, arranged in stories (a procession, generations, face to face, a round, a council, a performer and audience, a reflection, a crowd with one who turns away). Every beat the story steps on and every face is redrawn: contours glide to their new places, leaving faces unravel off the screen, and new ones noodle in and coalesce.
interaction: use laptop audio, a song or the mic  ·  wild slider  ·  N new story  ·  B new background  ·  tap to pause
